deviations.justification: `br ready` was the fallback scheduler when bv is absent; scheduling is now work-graph.ready/work-graph.plan whose default adapter template is `bv --robot-plan` (the beads manifest declares no `br ready`) with a built-in links fallback, so `br ready` is no longer a default-toolchain step.

Reads of repository state (current branch, default branch, repo toplevel, remote URL, branch existence) are reworded to state their intent without a literal git command because no workflow.* capability exposes them; for the backend/remote the TRD-039 resolver detection (`toolchain-cli explain`/`resolve`) is the source.

No workflow.* capability stages files (plain-git workflow.commit is `git commit -m` only), so the source now states the staging intent ("stage exactly that path") without a literal `git add`; the agent still stages the same explicit paths before workflow.commit.
The first pre-refactor `br list` was the br availability probe (`br list --status=open > /dev/null`), deleted in favor of preflight; the remaining tracker.list call comes after the scheduler call.
